...Bahut achha. Textbook knowledge recovered. The people before me, I could now explain as a paragraph in a book. Actual situation mein kya badla? Nothing.

A few things became understandable. Fuki's manner. House isolated in the mountains, yet not particularly poor. The Emishi's complicated position, all of it somehow packed into this one small house.

Except the child's cheerfulness. Woh kis chapter mein tha? Where did that fit? The explanation had accounted for an entire people and forgotten the little person presently jumping about in front of me.

Kageaki"From Kamakura."
Funa"Kamakuraaa... Never been, but I know! Big city?"
Kageaki"Yes. At present, the de facto capital of Yamato."
Funa"De-fakto capital?"
Kageaki"Capital means the foremost city of a country. De facto means it is not really that, but for practical purposes it is more or less that. Officially no, practically yes."
Funa"Kamakura is... like the number-one city?"
Kageaki"Yes."
Funa"Where's the really-real capital?"
Kageaki"Kyoto, in Yamashiro Province. Even now, for Kinki and the lands farther west, it may be called the center. However..."
Kageaki"Nearly all of western Yamato is still recovering from the war. The recovery proceeds very slowly. Kyoto can only be as lively as those circumstances permit."
Funa"Kamakura is more amazing?"
Kageaki"Many people are there."
Funa"How many?"
Kageaki"Twice the people of this village. Then ten times that. Then roughly a hundred times that."
Funa"Waaaah! That much amazing..."

en.html:
The two old men met each other's eyes. Silence came down.

Nobody spoke. Nobody moved. Pehle woh dono. Until those two moved, the rest of us apparently possessed no permission from our own bodies.

Tees saal. Thirty years. The magistrate's words had become something solid, filling the room. I could not step between them. What would I bring? A few minutes of acquaintance against thirty years?

Hands and feet felt bound. Breathing also had become difficult.

Yagenta"...This life gave me nothing? Nahin. That is not my view."
Nagasaka"Mine it is. Kuch nahin mila. Nothing."
Yagenta"..."

Yagenta"Why should I not say so?"
Nagasaka"Because THAT was not what you wanted."

Nagasaka"...Achha. Keep that claim. Then why challenge me now?"
Yagenta"So regret does not follow me into the next world also. Either Ichihime or I had to stop your foolishness. Ichihime is gone. Main bacha hoon. I remain."
Yagenta"Leave my duty here and I will lose my way on the road to the dead. Ukyo, your epitaph will be my last work."
Nagasaka"Then mine is carving yours? Hmph. Too much labor. Even dead, you want me to work."
Nagasaka"Dogs ko de doonga. Leave you to the dogs. Finished. No objection?"
Yagenta"None!"
